<documents>
<document id="account-name-change">
ChangingˆyourˆlegalˆnameˆIfˆyourˆlegalˆnameˆhasˆchanged,ˆforˆexampleˆafterˆmarriageˆorˆdivorce,ˆourˆVerificationˆteamˆcanˆupdateˆit.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyou'llˆneedˆ-ˆAˆphotoˆIDˆinˆyourˆnewˆname,ˆorˆyourˆcurrentˆIDˆplusˆaˆlegalˆdocumentˆshowingˆtheˆchange,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆmarriageˆcertificateˆorˆcourtˆorderˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆrequestˆitˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆaskˆtoˆchangeˆyourˆlegalˆname.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆchangeˆitˆdirectly,ˆbutˆwillˆpassˆtheˆrequestˆtoˆtheˆVerificationˆteamˆandˆtellˆyouˆhowˆtoˆuploadˆtheˆdocuments.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆUpˆtoˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆafterˆweˆreceiveˆyourˆdocuments.ˆ##ˆDateˆofˆbirthˆIfˆyourˆdateˆofˆbirthˆisˆwrongˆonˆyourˆaccount,ˆtheˆsameˆprocessˆapplies.ˆ##ˆYourˆcardˆOnceˆtheˆchangeˆisˆapproved,ˆyouˆcanˆorderˆaˆcardˆinˆyourˆnewˆname.ˆReplacementˆfeesˆfollowˆyourˆplan,ˆbutˆweˆwaiveˆtheˆfeeˆforˆnameˆchanges.ˆ##ˆPreferredˆnameˆYouˆcanˆsetˆaˆpreferredˆfirstˆnameˆforˆtheˆappˆyourselfˆunderˆProfile.ˆItˆdoesn'tˆchangeˆyourˆlegalˆname.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="cushion-negative-after-dispute">
NegativeˆbalanceˆafterˆaˆdisputeˆYourˆbalanceˆcanˆgoˆnegativeˆwhenˆweˆtakeˆbackˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆafterˆaˆdisputeˆisˆdenied,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆdepositˆisˆreturned.ˆThisˆisn'tˆCushion,ˆandˆitˆcanˆhappenˆonˆanyˆplan,ˆincludingˆBasic.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhappensˆAˆprovisionalˆcreditˆisˆmoneyˆweˆlendˆyouˆwhileˆaˆdisputeˆisˆinvestigated.ˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆisˆdenied,ˆweˆgiveˆyouˆwrittenˆnoticeˆandˆtakeˆitˆbackˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆlater.ˆIfˆyou'veˆspentˆitˆinˆtheˆmeantime,ˆtheˆbalanceˆcanˆdropˆbelowˆzero.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆyourˆbalanceˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆAnyˆincomingˆdepositˆrepaysˆitˆautomatically.ˆ##ˆFeesˆThereˆareˆnoˆfeesˆforˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆ($0.00).ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆisn'tˆrepaidˆAsˆwithˆCushion,ˆifˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆlastsˆ60ˆdays,ˆtheˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆuntilˆit'sˆrepaid.ˆOnˆPlusˆandˆPremium,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspendedˆwhileˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆnegativeˆforˆlongerˆthanˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆCan'tˆpayˆitˆrightˆaway?ˆMessageˆsupport.ˆIfˆyou'reˆgoingˆthroughˆfinancialˆhardship,ˆweˆcanˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="account-under-review">
AccountˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆSometimesˆweˆneedˆtoˆreviewˆanˆaccount,ˆforˆexampleˆtoˆconfirmˆidentityˆdetails,ˆcheckˆunusualˆactivity,ˆorˆmeetˆlegalˆrequirements.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆcanˆdoˆduringˆaˆreviewˆYouˆcanˆstillˆreceiveˆdeposits.ˆDependingˆonˆtheˆreview,ˆyouˆmayˆnotˆbeˆableˆtoˆsendˆmoney,ˆwithdrawˆcash,ˆuseˆyourˆcardˆorˆorderˆaˆnewˆcard.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyou'llˆseeˆAˆbannerˆinˆtheˆappˆtellsˆyouˆtheˆaccountˆisˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestricted,ˆandˆwhatˆweˆneedˆfromˆyou,ˆifˆanything.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆItˆdependsˆonˆtheˆreason.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆdocuments,ˆsendingˆthemˆquicklyˆisˆtheˆbestˆwayˆtoˆspeedˆthingsˆup.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆhelp?ˆSupportˆcan'tˆliftˆaˆreviewˆorˆrestriction,ˆandˆoftenˆcan'tˆshareˆtheˆreason.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆmessageˆtoˆtheˆVerificationˆteam,ˆwhoˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆrestrictionsˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆbecauseˆofˆaˆnegativeˆbalance,ˆaddingˆmoneyˆliftsˆtheˆrestrictionˆonceˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
